scope: Live occupancy geometry and seamless cell editing
environment: Single existing in-app browser tab; not an iPhone device performance certification

occupancy.implementation: Live and committed photo crop share reframeBasePhoto; live object and pattern positions use the committed geometry mapping

seamlessCellEditing.note: Full-source effect processing and seamless texture transfer still need performance work. An experimental texSubImage2D change regressed throughput and was removed.

quality: No gesture-specific reduction in source resolution or sampling quality
